probes.name: P8a
probes.subject: .claude/hooks/stop_continuation.py
probes.old:
# chain so the next session starts fresh.
    _log_decision(decision, "none", event)
probes.new: # chain so the next session starts fresh.
probes.note: PLAN-0122 AC-8 P8a. Removes the log append on the fall-through pause arm — the arm that fires for `pause` AND any unrecognized verdict. The pause case's A1 (post == pre + 1) must redden: without this line a paused turn leaves no trace, which is precisely the hole AC-12 would divide by. Run against the [pause] case ALONE and not the whole parametrization, because this mutation also reddens [transport-pause] through the same arm, and two failing testcases classify as MISFIRE rather than crediting either claim.

probes.name: P8a-control
probes.subject: .claude/hooks/stop_continuation.py
probes.old:
# chain so the next session starts fresh.
    _log_decision(decision, "none", event)
probes.new: # chain so the next session starts fresh.
probes.note: AC-8's stated control — 'the proceed case stays green' — made mechanical instead of left as prose. Same mutation as P8a, different arm: the proceed path logs at its own call site, so removing the pause append must NOT reach it. If this ever reads WITNESSED, P8a's RED was never evidence about the pause arm specifically and the whole AC-8 reading collapses. Credits nothing by design (only WITNESSED credits).

probes.name: P8b
probes.subject: .claude/hooks/stop_continuation.py
probes.note: PLAN-0122 AC-8 P8b. The contentless floor demotes a proceed to silence; this makes the log claim the agent received a block instead. A1 stays GREEN (still exactly one line) and the run reaches A2, so this witnesses 'the line says what the agent RECEIVED' on its own — the half that is NOT recoverable from the verdict, and the reason the `emitted` field exists at all.

probes.name: P9a
probes.subject: .claude/hooks/stop_continuation.py
probes.note: PLAN-0122 AC-9 P9a (SD-5 keep-branch), verbatim: add `no` and `operation` to _META_REASON_TOKENS. Widening the floor makes it catch more of the 117 real recorded proceed reasons, so the pinned equality reddens and a future widening cannot happen silently. The test's three positive controls run FIRST and stay green — 117 rows still parse, 'continue' and 'ok' still demote — which is what makes this RED evidence about the count rather than about a broken parser.

probes.name: P10a
probes.subject: tools/hook_copies_audit.py
probes.old: subject: len({c.hashes[subject] for c in [main, *worktrees]}) for subject in SUBJECTS
probes.new: subject: len({c.hashes[subject] for c in [main]}) for subject in SUBJECTS
probes.note: PLAN-0122 AC-10 P10a. The AC states the control as 'a temp worktree with one changed byte -> K increments'; the fixture already builds that worktree, so the mutation is the other half — stop folding the worktree copies into the hash set. `report.worktrees == 1` asserts FIRST and stays green (discovery is untouched), so the RED lands on distinct[STOP_HOOK] == 2 and witnesses that the tool actually READS each copy rather than counting the directories it found.
